title: S3 gauge correction optimizer/certificate frontier with complete physical front-end constraints

local_certificate.consequence: Any globally better gauge must differ from the incumbent in at least four of the 39 movable line labels.

variables.x_line_label: x[i,a] in {0,1}; i=0..39, a in S3 labels 0..5
variables.y_edge_identity: y[e] in {0,1}; e=0..539; y[e]=1 iff residual transport is identity

hard_constraints: sum_a x[i,a] = 1 for every line i
for each skew-line constraint e=(i,j), y[e] is allowed only for label pairs satisfying the S3 identity residual relation
milp_max2csp_schema.objective: maximize sum_e y[e], equivalently minimize 540 - sum_e y[e] corrections

search_frontier.next_exact_solver_target: prove objective <= 210 or produce a witness with >=211 identity edges subject to the same 540 S3 constraints

boundary: BT1421 is an exact optimizer schema plus incumbent/local/physical-front-end certificate. It does not claim global optimality of the 330 correction bound; it states the remaining proof obligation in solver-ready form.
